cohort: The study included preterm infants born < 32 weeks gestational age undergoing a clinically indicated transition from CPAP to HFNC following at least 2 weeks of respiratory support.
finding: Transitioning from CPAP to HFNC did not consistently decrease lung aeration in stable preterm infants, though a distinct respiratory pattern with decreased EELI and frequent recruitment breaths was observed in the infant who failed transition.
